text_1981: Proclaim: "If the Most Gracious did have a son, I would still be the foremost worshiper."
text_1989: Proclaim: “If the Most Gracious did have a son, I would be the first to worship Him (anyway).”
text_ref: Proclaim: "If the Most Gracious did have a son, I would still be the foremost worshiper."

text_1981: Be He glorified; He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord with the great dominion, far above their claims.
text_1989: Be He glorified; He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord with the great dominion, far above their claims.
text_ref: Be He glorified; He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord with the great dominion, far above their claims.

text_1981: Let them blunder and play until they meet their day that is awaiting them.
text_1989: Let them blunder and play until they meet their day that is awaiting them.
text_ref: Let them blunder and play until they meet their day that is awaiting them.

text_1981: He is the only One who is a deity in the heaven and a deity on earth. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.
text_1989: He is the only god in the heaven and the only god on earth, and He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.
text_ref: He is the only One who is a deity in the heaven and a deity on earth. He is the Most Wise, the Omniscient.

text_1981: Most Exalted is the One who possesses all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. With Him is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world), and to Him you will be returned.
text_1989: Most Exalted is the One who posses­ ses the kingship of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. about the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.
text_ref: Most Exalted is the One who possesses all sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them. With Him is the knowledge about the Hour (end of the world), and to Him you will be returned.

text_1981: None of those whom they idolize beside Him possess any power to intercede, unless their intercession coincides with the truth, and they fully know.
text_1989: None of those whom they idolize besides Him possess any power to intercede, unless their intercession coincides with the truth, and they are aware thereof.
text_ref: None of those whom they idolize beside Him possess any power to intercede, unless their intercession coincides with the truth, and they fully know.

text_1981: If you asked them who created them, they would say, "GOD." Why then did they deviate?
text_1989: If you asked them who created them, they would say, “GOD.” Why then did they deviate?
text_ref: If you asked them who created them, they would say, "GOD." Why then did they deviate?

text_1981: They will be declared as disbelievers. 89.
text_1989: It is proclaimed: “O my Lord, these people do not believe.”
text_ref: It will be proclaimed: "O my Lord, these people do not believe."

text_1981: You shall disregard them and say, "Peace;" they will surely find out.
text_1989: Disregard them and say, “Peace;” they will surely find out. 1 2274 496
